item.title: Unseasonably warm through the end of March
item.description: We hoped you liked yesterday's weather... because today will look and feel very similar... and the next day... and the next. -Meteorologist Kristen Currie

item.title: These are the best places to live in the US for 2026, study finds
item.description: What is the ideal place to live in the United States? A new study claims to have the answer.

item.title: No green thumb? Try Texas' new Wild Thumb app
item.description: The Texas Parks and Wildlife Foundation has launched a new mobile app called "Wild Thumb" to help residents incorporate native plants into their yards and gardens.

item.title: SH 130 to become test route for new driverless freight trucks
item.description: The future of freight is speeding toward reality quicker than you might think, and it's happening right in Austin's own backyard.

item.title: Plans to return to countywide voting for runoff in Williamson County
item.description: During the March primary, many Williamson County voters encountered long lines and confusion after the county reverted to precinct‑specific voting on Election Day — a change several residents said they didn’t know about.

item.title: Union leaders discuss direct impacts of partial government shutdown on TSA agents, airports
item.description: Leaders from the American Federation of Government Employees (AFGE) -- the union representing Transportation Security Administration (TSA) agents -- will hold a press call on Tuesday afternoon to detail how the partial government shutdown is impacting agents who are working without pay.

item.title: Hutto Police Department welcomes Williamson County's first ever Crisis Response K9
item.description: The Hutto Police Department has welcomed a new team member to its ranks, making history for the county in the process.

item.title: Another company to launch robotaxis in Austin this week
item.description: Robotaxis are becoming more and more commonplace in large cities. Hundreds of Waymos and Tesla Robotaxis are already operating on Austin's streets, and another company's version is set to roll out this week, too.

item.title: Some Austin council members suggest 'clawing back' money for cap and stitch roadway elements
item.description: At a work session Tuesday, some Austin City Council members suggested they were open to "clawing back" some of the $104 million in funding they previously approved to build the roadway elements for 'caps and stitches' -- or decks with parks on them -- over the state's I-35 highway expansion.

item.title: Central Texas woman fosters community, inclusion in higher education through her leadership
item.description: KXAN received several nominations for our Remarkable Women contest, describing Dr. Shawntal Brown as a transformative, remarkable leader as the president of the Texas Association of Diversity Officers in Higher Education.

item.title: Semi truck stuck under the 11th Street bridge blocking lanes of I-35
item.description: The traffic incident is at 1100 northbound I-35.

item.title: 'Mission accomplished': Texas officials say state-funded border wall complete
item.description: The State of Texas spent $3 billion to build 82 miles of border wall but says it isn't building any more.

item.title: Still too warm for March, but pattern change ahead
item.description: It's hard to complain about the nice weather we've been spoiled with recently, but we're desperate for rain, and there's hope on the horizon. -Meteorologist Kristen Currie

item.title: Southwest Airlines celebrates new crew base at the Austin airport
item.description: Southwest Airlines and Austin leaders will celebrate the airline's new crew base at Austin-Bergstrom International Airport on Wednesday morning.

item.title: Experimental UT cancer drug tricks immune system into attacking tumors like a virus
item.description: Researchers at UT Austin and UT MD Anderson say an experimental chemotherapy drug prompts cancer cells to mimic viral infections, triggering an immune response that attacks tumors and may reduce the need for higher chemo doses.
